Default data_as_elements converts span and div with data-as

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
